meta.title: Estimates — three quotes supplied by the requester
meta.source: The three figures below are first-party data: they were given to this project by the property owner, who received them from the named companies on 2026-08-30. They are the requester's own records, not research findings.
meta.verification: No official source can confirm a private quotation. Each amount is therefore published with verified=false. Nothing has been added, rounded, averaged or inferred, and no market benchmark is substituted for a missing figure.
meta.why_not_blank: The project rule blanks values that research could not confirm. These are not research values: they are the only cost evidence that exists for this job, supplied by the owner. Blanking them would delete primary data, so they are shown with an explicit unverified label and listed on the Flagged for Review page (F-01). Any figure the owner does not want public can be removed on request.
meta.not_published: Third-party 'typical cost' benchmarks (HomeGuide, Angi and similar) were deliberately left out: they are not official sources and cannot be verified, so under the project rule they carry no place in a sourced table.

estimates.scope_as_quoted: Remove bathtub wastewater overflow trip lever — replacing waste and overflow
estimates.match_basis: Company name on the quote matches the CSLB licensee name exactly, and the CSLB business address is in San Francisco. The quote itself was not seen by this project.

estimates.scope_as_quoted: Replace lever for the bathtub plug and spout with diverter — includes labour and materials
estimates.scope_class: lever plus spout diverter, labour and materials
estimates.match_basis: Company name matches the CSLB licensee name exactly and the CSLB business address is in San Francisco. The quote itself was not seen by this project.

estimates.scope_as_quoted: Repair or adjust bathtub wastewater plunger handle
estimates.scope_class: repair or adjustment of the existing mechanism
estimates.match_basis: CSLB licence 1024971 is held by JOSEPH TINSLEY dba FAST RESPONSE PLUMBING AND ROOTER. 'Fast Response' on the quote is a partial name match, so the match is probable but not certain.

analysis.heading: The three quotes are not comparable
analysis.detail: Only one is a repair. E-03 at is to repair or adjust the existing plunger handle; E-02 at replaces the lever and spout diverter with labour and materials; E-01 at replaces the waste-and-overflow assembly. Choosing on price alone would compare an adjustment with two replacements. The decision is instead which scope the job actually needs, which cannot be settled until someone inspects the overflow from the tub side.

analysis.heading: No quote covers drywall
analysis.detail: None of the three quoted scopes mentions opening or patching a ceiling. If access from below is required, all three figures are incomplete by the drywall component and by any make-good of the storage-unit ceiling.

analysis.heading: Every quoted company is plumbing-only on its own licence
analysis.detail: Licences 977638, 757796 and 1024971 each hold C-36 Plumbing alone. A single contract covering both plumbing and drywall therefore needs either a B-licensed prime contractor (BPC §7057(b)) or two coordinated contractors. The one route that may already exist is licence 749536 at the same address and phone as the quoter, which holds B + C-36 (F-06).

analysis.heading: Permit cost is not a fixed number
analysis.detail: The San Francisco permit fee depends on the declared scope and valuation. DBI publishes the fee schedule (linked in Sources); no figure is reproduced here because the valuation is not known and inventing one would breach the project rule.

_amounts_policy: Quote amounts withheld: no official source confirms them. Published figures and labels live in site-data/ and on the canonical pages at the repository root.
